title: Chapter 1377 - 3: You Have The Gray Ancestor, I Have The Galaxy
content:
Chapter 1377 - 3: You Have The Gray Ancestor, I Have The Galaxy

Chapter 1377: Chapter 3: You Have the Gray Ancestor, I Have the Galaxy

But as an independent dimensional space, its level is inherently consistent with the Chaos Void, and the essence of its operation also has merits.

Why do the time beings of the First Realm yearn so much to explore more dimensional spaces? It is because this practice brings sufficient benefits and advantages to oneself.

Before stepping into the Thirteenth Layer, Lin Yuan hadn’t thought much about the more than ten dimensional spaces explored before.

But now as a time being, the elevated perspective gives Lin Yuan a sense of ’turning around suddenly, that person is at the dim end of the light.’

The same thing might be perceived completely differently by time beings and non-time beings.

"Dimensional space! Dimensional space!"

"I understand now."

Lin Yuan was radiant with energy.

The seventh layer of the "Infinite Void" was quickly established.

This insight, although it did not fully comprehend the complete seventh layer, at least managed to comprehend the first third of it.

This is quite normal. The comprehension of the Great Dao methodologies cannot be achieved in one go; it must be step-by-step. The complete seventh layer of the "Infinite Void" involves a gap in power that is too vast.

...

Rumble.

The inner universe.

The spacetime of all directions suddenly roared.

The initial establishment of the seventh layer of the "Infinite Void" immediately reflected on the inner universe.

In an instant, the spacetime Great Dao of the inner universe became more stable, the most microscopic particles intertwined and enmeshed, no longer existing independently.

"This?"

Beside the jade gourd, the red-dressed girl watched her surroundings in shock.

Ever since Lin Yuan mastered the fifth layer of the "Infinite Void," she lost all concept of the path Lin Yuan was taking.

Now, with the inner universe transforming once more, the red-dressed girl couldn’t help but feel a certain suffocation.

"The master’s inner universe... even the old master can’t compare now, right."

The thoughts of the red-dressed girl were difficult to calm.

She had experienced the inner universe of Lord Mo Xu, yet compared to Lin Yuan now... it was clearly inferior.

In fact, what the red-dressed girl sensed of Lin Yuan’s inner universe was only a part of it.

Even so, in her heart, it had already surpassed Lord Mo Xu.

"Old master..."

The red-dressed girl steadied herself, knowing that Lord Mo Xu had two purposes in spreading his own legacy.

One was to nurture a new time being for the Chaos Void.

The second was to perfect his own Dao with the help of the beings in the Chaos Void.

But now, seeing the boundless unfathomableness of Lin Yuan’s inner universe, naturally, the red-dressed girl’s heart was full of emotion.

...

On the other side of the inner universe.

As the surrounding spacetime became increasingly stable.

The spirit of the Magic Origin Fruit Tree, which had been drifting in this region, couldn’t help but shiver.

"Master, master."

The spirit of the Magic Origin Fruit Tree immediately began calling to Lin Yuan.

"What is it?"

Lin Yuan descended with an avatar, watching the gradually surging aura of the Magic Origin Fruit Tree, with a peculiar expression.

"Master, I’m about to break through."

The spirit of the Magic Origin Fruit Tree spoke with urgency.

Compared to the breakthrough of life within dimensions, following a perfected Dao.

The breakthrough for life like the Magic Origin Fruit Tree, born from dimensional gaps, is often uncontrollable.

"Breakthrough?"

Lin Yuan watched the Magic Origin Fruit Tree.

In terms of realm, the Magic Origin Fruit Tree naturally reached the twelfth layer’s completeness.

If it is to break through, it can only be from the twelfth layer to the thirteenth layer.

Which means, the Magic Origin Fruit Tree is about to become a time being.

Of course, the premise is to pass the test and break through the time cycle.

"Breakthrough then."

Lin Yuan did not stop it.

With his current strength, the Magic Origin Fruit Tree was almost akin to a vase.

Only by breaking through to the thirteenth layer can it provide some assistance to Lin Yuan.

In fact, in the vast dimensional gaps, many time beings are willing to follow some powerful thirteenth layers.

For instance, the Time Lords?

Every Time Lord has time beings following them.

The most important reason is that Time Lords have the means to completely kill time beings.

Time beings can observe future timelines and manifest countless avatars, making them extremely difficult to kill, as difficult as reaching for the sky.

But Time Lords, as long as they don’t hesitate, can go to the past spacetime and kill the weaker past selves of the Time Lord.

Thus, the difficulty naturally drops drastically.

Buzz~ Instantly, with Lin Yuan’s agreement.

The Magic Origin Fruit Tree chose to break through immediately.

At once, an invisible force permeated the inner universe of Lin Yuan, enveloping the Magic Origin Fruit Tree, which fell into a loop formed by threads of time power.

The time cycle from the twelfth layer to the thirteenth layer is formed by the operation of the Supreme Rule Dao, and even Lin Yuan, the creator of the inner universe, cannot interfere at all.

The Magic Origin Fruit Tree must rely on itself to become a time being.

"Hopefully, it can succeed."

Lin Yuan watched the Magic Origin Fruit Tree fall into the time cycle area from afar.

Countless future timelines unfolded before him, and based on Lin Yuan’s observation of the future, the probability of the Magic Origin Fruit Tree becoming a time being is not high.

But however slight, there is still a possibility of becoming a time being.

Before charging into the thirteenth layer, Luo Hou also did not attract much attention from existing time beings, as they felt the probability of crossing into the thirteenth layer was low.

But in the end, didn’t they still become a newly promoted time being?

Therefore.

Lin Yuan remains hopeful that the Magic Origin Fruit Tree can step into the thirteenth layer.

After all, Lin Yuan wouldn’t lose much if it failed, and if it succeeded, it would naturally be better, adding a time being to his ranks.

If it fails, there is not much loss, as the Magic Origin Fruit Tree was acquired casually by Lin Yuan, without any cost.

"The Supreme Rule Dao?"

Lin Yuan carefully felt the time cycle area formed in the depths of the inner universe.
